item.title: Archives now restored - Society for Irish Latin American Studies
item.description: We have been working hard to restore access to the older SILAS archives, as they are such a valuable resource. We are delighted to announce that the files are now accessible under the Archive of Irish Settlement tab. Best viewed on a laptop or PC, as these old files are not mobile friendly.
